entities.summary: Nicholas Ryan Allen is an American professional baseball shortstop and second baseman for the Houston Astros of Major League Baseball (MLB). He has previously played in MLB for the Oakland Athletics and Atlanta Braves. Allen made his MLB debut in 2022.
